children: Glencore said copper production rose in the third quarter and reiterated its guidance for the year.
The commodities company said Thursday that copper production rose 2% from the second quarter to 201,600 metric tons. Output in the year to date was up 2.6% at 598,600 tons.
Gold production fell 6% from the previous quarter to 94,000 ounces, with silver down 10% at 4 million ounces.  Steelmaking and energy coal output rose 14% and 8%, respectively.
For the full year, copper production is expected at the lower end of the 810,000-870,000 tons range, with steelmaking coal seen toward the lower end of the 30 million-32 million ton guidance range.
The company said it also expects 2026 marketing-adjusted earnings before interest and taxes to exceed $5 billion.
